correctness.rationale: For every geometric smooth parameter bΔ≠0, f=xg(x³) is separable with genus four; exact f³ coefficient extraction gives the 4x4 Cartier matrix H with det H=3b²LR². The restrictions L|R=0=-a²(a+2)² and Δ|R=0=2a(a+2)³ prove distinct smooth-base Hasse components. On R=0 the rank-one two-dimensional block is u v^T and its second Cartier iterate is governed by v^[7]u=3S, not ordinary matrix trace. The factorization S(a,3a(a+1))=(a-2)(a-3)(a+1)²(a³+3a²-1) and smoothness exclusions prove exactly five deep points and all rank cases. Two actual exact programs recomputed coefficients and finite-field Cartier iterates (entire F7/F49 smooth bases, selected F343 cubic orbit). Finite enumeration is corroboration, not proof of geometric exhaustiveness.

value.rationale: The result is a complete arithmetic stratification of the natural identical published two-parameter automorphism-six genus-four hyperelliptic family, not an arbitrary numerical parameter slice. The elliptic quotient Hasse curve and the distinct nonreduced Prym-degeneration parabola explain rank behavior. The semilinear nilpotence calculation identifies five exact minimal-rank fibers and Frobenius orbits over every finite extension, while the classification covers all geometric smooth coefficients. This sharpens known superspeciality-only information without asserting Newton-polygon or isomorphism classifications.
